stem_book: A hinged construction consists of three rhombuses (with corresponding sides parallel, so all three have the same angles) whose sides are in the ratio 5 : 3 : 2, the left vertex A₀ being hinged to a fixed wall. Vertex A₃ moves in the horizontal direction at a velocity v. Velocity of A₂ is : (a) 2.5 v (b) 1.5 v (c) (2/3)v (d) 0.8 v
reason: added the fixed vertex A₀ (figure) and the similar-rhombus condition the 5 : 3 : 2 ratio relies on
work: similar rhombi ⇒ horizontal diagonals ∝ 5 : 3 : 2 ⇒ x(A₂)/x(A₃) = 8/10 ⇒ v(A₂) = 0.8v
